title: Sha'awa a Ɗakin Tsarki
intro: Ka shiga cikin wurin ibada mai natsuwa ka ga wani bawan Allah mai ibada yana tsaye yana addu'a. Hannuwansu a ɗaga, idanunsu a ɗaga, zuciyarsu kuma tana ɗauke da sha'awa wadda ta daɗe tana wanzuwa. Wanene wannan rai mai haƙuri wanda amincinsa ga Allah bai taɓa raguwa ba?
clues: Na shafe shekaru masu yawa ina ibada da addu'a, ina ganin mu'ujizai da suka ƙarfafa bangaskiyata.
An ba ni nauyin kula da wani matashi mai albarka a cikin wurin ibada.
Yayin da na tsufa, babban baƙin cikina shi ne rashin haihuwa, domin matata ba ta da haihuwa kuma dukanmu mun tsufa.
Na yi addu'a ga Ubangijina don ya maye gurbina daga iyalina, wanda zai ci gaba da gadon annabci.
Yayin da nake tsaye a wurin addu'a, mala'iku suka kira ni, suna cewa, 'Allah yana ba ka albishir', sai tsoro da fargaba suka kama ni.
An gaya min zan haifi ɗa mai suna Yahya, sunan da ba a taɓa ba wa kowa ba a da, kuma a matsayin alama ba zan yi magana da mutane ba har tsawon kwana uku.

trial.answer: Bakarariya da tsufa yayin da ake son magaji nagari

outcome.label: Sakamako
options: An ba shi ɗa nagari kuma ya sake magana bayan kwana uku na shiru
Ambaliyar ruwa ta halaka shi saboda rashin imani

outcome.answer: An ba shi ɗa nagari kuma ya sake magana bayan kwana uku na shiru

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
